name: ball_proximity_2v2_a_rear_man_leaving_the_striker_is_paid
description: 2v2: blue0 is parked 310 uu from the ball and blue1 starts right beside it (about 365 uu from the ball, crowded: both weigh 1/2, potential 0.723) and drives straight away at 1000 uu/s for 30 steps (2 s, ending 2000+ uu out: spaced, weights 1 and 1/2, potential about 0.83). With the old closest-car-only form this was worth only the hold tax, -0.082 over the run; now the climb in potential outweighs the tax and the run pays about +0.059 at constant speed (hand estimate), measured about +0.03 because the car's speed varies. Both blue cars are paid the same. Band 0.0 .. 0.09.

expect.intent: backing the second man off pays the team (the old form paid -0.082)
